title: SpinPath Model Configuration
description: Configuration for a SpinPath model, supporting various model types.

architecture_name.description: Name of the model architecture (e.g., 'ResNet50', 'ABMIL', 'UNIv2', 'RetCCL'). This name is used to identify how to construct or load the model.

architecture_params.description: Parameters specific to the model architecture. Examples: {'input_dim': 1024, 'output_dim': 256} for a custom MLP, or {'timm_model_name': 'resnet50', 'pretrained': true} for a TIMM-based model. Can also include 'weights_file': 'custom_weights.pth' for non-standard HF weight file names.

patch_size_um.description: The size of the input patch in micrometers (e.g., 128, 224, 256). Assumed to be square if a single number is provided.

feature_extractor.description: Identifier for an upstream feature extractor. Used if 'model_type' is 'trainable_classifier' and it operates on pre-computed features, or if this model itself is a feature extractor that fine-tunes/modifies another.

num_classes.description: The number of output classes. Required if 'model_type' is 'torchscript' or 'trainable_classifier'.

class_names.description: Names of the output classes. Length must match 'num_classes'. Required if 'model_type' is 'torchscript' or 'trainable_classifier'.
